title: Lower bound on the free coordinates within a set
statement:
Fix $n$ and a parameter $p$ with $0 \le p \le 1$, let $U \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ be a set of coordinates, and let $k \ge 1$ be an integer satisfying $3k \le p\,\abs{U}$. Draw a Bernoulli($p$) random restriction $\rho$ on $n$ variables, and let $J$ denote its set of free variables. Then
\[
  \Pr\bigl[\,k \le \abs{U \cap J}\,\bigr] \;\ge\; \frac{1}{4}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: U a finite set of coordinates in Fin n
replaced:
Let $0 \le p \le 1$, let $U$ be a set of coordinates and let $k \ge 1$ satisfy
$3k \le p\abs{U}$. Then, under a Bernoulli($p$)-random restriction with free set $J$,
\[
  \Pr\bigl[k \le \abs{U \cap J}\bigr] \;\ge\; \frac{1}{4},
\]
which is the form consumed by the concentration transfer of O'Donnell Lemma 4.21.
